title: Thai Chicken Satay
description: A classic Thai street food dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with peanut sauce for an authentic experience.
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic, lemongrass, and chili flakes. Blend until smooth.
Add the blended mixture to a large bowl and whisk in the peanut oil.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and sprinkle with Croatian sea salt.
Serve with peanut sauce for dipping, if desired.
Note: To make peanut sauce, combine peanut butter, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and honey in a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy.
